data.name: Slay and Spray Exterminators
data.detailed_description:
Following 500 years of war against the dreaded Soyjak hordes, humanity has emerged mostly triumphant, but at a great cost, rifts open and close across the planet, bringing forth waves of warped and mutated creatures from other realms, all of which augur naught but destruction. To truly prevail against such foes, the one true king must yet again enlist the help of his infinite army of Replicex (Replicated Exterminators) to capture enough of these beings to empower the Great Planar Seal and quell the tides forever.

Gameplay:

Slay and Spray Exterminators is a co-op procedurally-generated dungeon crawler with light roguelike elements in which players can wield a variety of additional tools alongside their standard kit of a Stun Baton, Capture Grenade, and Omnitool. Fight your way through maze-like interiors of office buildings, sewers, and more, all with the goal of safely and effectively capturing every creature you come across.

Features:

  • Randomly generated dungeon spaces that defy the reality you've come to expect;

  • Consumable tools and items with interesting and powerful effects;

  • Full character customisation - you can change everything down to the textures;

  • A curated variety of enemy types, each with their own distinct gimmicks;

  • Unique unlockables only obtained from delving into the depths;

  • Full uncapped online co-op, play with as many friends as you can find!

data.short_description: Play as a newly-spawned Exterminator, custom built to safely capture the grievous enemies of humanity. Upgrade your arsenal by completing missions to unlock a wide variety of new equipment to help you with your holy task; of course, a new cosmetic every now and then couldn't hurt too, right?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 3.6GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
